programme.title: Hell Is For Heroes
programme.desc: It's 1944, and Nazi forces along the Siegfried Line have the numbers, the fortifications and the firepower to break through. GIs have little more than a dogged determination and the ingenuity to fool the Germans into thinking they are allies.

programme.title: The Vikings
programme.desc: Legends Kirk Douglas, Tony Curtis, Ernest Borgnine and Janet Leigh dazzle in this epic chronicle of brutal rivalry and bloodthirsty ambition as two brothers are locked in a battle that will decide their fate...and that of a beautiful princess.

programme.title: The Buccaneer
programme.desc: General Andrew Jackson's dependence on the help of pirate Jean Lafitte to repel the British is complicated by the Governor's daughter. Set in New Orleans during the War of 1812.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible - Ghost Protocol
programme.desc: Agent Ethan Hunt and his elite team go underground after a bombing implicates them as terrorists. While trying to clear their name, the team uncovers a plot to start a nuclear war.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible - Rogue Nation
programme.desc: Ethan and team take on their most impossible mission yet, eradicating the Syndicate - an International rogue organization as highly skilled as they are, committed to destroying the IMF.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible - Dead Reckoning
programme.desc: Ethan Hunt (Tom Cruise) and his IMF team embark on their most dangerous mission yet: To track down a terrifying new weapon that threatens all of humanity before it falls into the hands of a mysterious, all-powerful enemy.

programme.title: In Dreams
programme.desc: Claire Cooper's (Annette Bening) peaceful family life takes a chilling turn when a mysterious serial killer (Robert Downey Jr.) invades her seemingly idylic New England town and haunts her dreams with dark clues to his next deadly moves.

programme.title: Carrie (2002)
programme.desc: Angela Bettis stars in this adaptation of Stephen King's classic tale of horror. Carrie White has been cursed with the power of telekinesis and when her tormenters commit an act of unforgivable humiliation, they'll soon learn a deadly lesson.

programme.title: Stephen King's Thinner
programme.desc: An obese attorney accidentally runs down and kills an old gypsy woman. After her ancient father puts a curse on him, he starts losing weight, and cannot stop. Based on the Stephen King novel, written under the pseudonym Richard Bachman.

programme.title: Four Brothers
programme.desc: After their adoptive mother is murdered during a grocery store hold-up, the Mercer bros reunite to take the matter into their own hands. As they track down the killer, they quickly realize that their old ways of doing business have new consequences.

programme.title: Jackie Brown
programme.desc: A female flight attendant becomes a key figure in a plot between the police and an arms dealer.

programme.title: Courage Under Fire
programme.desc: A tank commander reviews another officer's candidacy for a posthumous medal.

programme.title: Fist of Fury
programme.desc: Bruce Lee stars as Chen Zhen, a martial arts protégé who returns to his former school in Shanghai when he learns that his beloved instructor has been murdered. To avenge his master's death, Chen must fight the greatest assassins from a rival school.

programme.title: The Way of the Dragon
programme.desc: Legendary Bruce Lee's only complete directorial film is packed with action and epic fight scenes. Lee visits his relatives at their restaurant in Italy and has to help them defend against brutal gangsters harassing them.

programme.title: A Game of Death
programme.desc: Billy Lo, a champion fighter and movie star, fakes his death to escape and then expose the crime syndicate that wants to control him.

programme.title: Daddy's Home
programme.desc: Will Ferrell & Mark Wahlberg face off in this Dad vs Step-Dad showdown! Brad (Ferrell) wants to be the best step-dad to his new wife's kids. But when their actual father, Dusty (Wahlberg), shows up, the two must go toe-to-toe in this fun family comedy.

programme.title: Election
programme.desc: Reese Witherspoon plays Tracy Flick, a straight-A go-getter determined to be president of Carver High’s student body. Popular teacher Jim McAllister (Broderick) decides to derail Tracy’s obsessive overachieving by recruiting an opposition candidate.

programme.title: Heartbreakers
programme.desc: Max and Page are a mother/daughter con team. Max targets wealthy men and marries them. Page then seduces them while Max "catches" her wayward husbands in the act. Then on to the next mark, posing in a variety of guises to keep one step ahead of the law.

programme.title: Miss Congeniality
programme.desc: International screen sensation Sandra Bullock stars as an FBI agent who goes undercover as a beauty contestant to capture a terrorist in this hilarious action-comedy.

programme.title: The First Wives Club
programme.desc: Join the Club - The First Wives Club, the good-time battle-of-the-sexes satire sparked by snappy one-liners, great physical-comedy gags, and three unforgettable stars in top form, Bette Midler, Goldie Hawn, and Diane Keaton.

programme.title: Sleepless in Seattle
programme.desc: Tom Hanks and Meg Ryan star in an enchanting romance about a widower whose son convinces him to find new love and the woman who answers his call.

programme.title: Failure to Launch
programme.desc: Tripp is a 35-year-old who still lives with his parents. And who can blame him? It’s free, he’s got a great room, and Mom does the laundry. Desperate to get him out of the house, his parents hire a gorgeous woman, Paula, to give him a little…push.

programme.title: The Taking of Pelham 123
programme.desc: Four ruthless hijackers take over a New York City subway train and hold the passengers for ransom. They threaten to shoot one each minute until the ransom is fully paid.

programme.title: Top Gun
programme.desc: Tom Cruise is superb as Maverick Mitchell, a young flyer who's out to become the best. And Kelly McGillis plays the instructor who teaches Maverick a few things you can't learn in a classroom.

programme.title: Thunderheart
programme.desc: Val Kilmer, Sam Shepard, and Graham Greene star in this murder mystery filled with style and suspense. Kilmer stars as Ray Levoi, a hotshot FBI agent who's thrust into a strange new world when he is sent to solve a murder on an Indian reservation.

programme.title: The Da Vinci Code
programme.desc: A murder in the Louvre and clues in Da Vinci's paintings lead to the discovery of a religious mystery protected by a secret society for two thousand years -- one that could shake the foundations of Christianity.

programme.title: The Patriot
programme.desc: In 1776, South Carolina widower and legendary war hero Benjamin Martin (Mel Gibson) finds himself thrust into the midst of the American Revolutionary War as he helplessly watches his family torn apart by the savage British Redcoats.

programme.title: Saving Private Ryan
programme.desc: A World War II captain (Tom Hanks) and his squad (Edward Burns, Tom Sizemore) risk all to locate and send home a soldier whose three brothers died in combat.

programme.title: The Social Network
programme.desc: The film focuses on the evolution of Facebook, the online social network created in 2004 on the Harvard campus, and how overnight success and wealth changed the lives of the classmates who created it.

programme.title: Dreamland
programme.desc: Discovering a fugitive bank robber (Margot Robbie) is hiding in his small town, a young man is torn between claiming the bounty on her head and his growing attraction to the seductive criminal, in this epic love story set during the Great Depression.

programme.title: The Homesman
programme.desc: Tommy Lee Jones stars in “the best western since UNFORGIVEN” (BBC). A low-life drifter helps a headstrong woman (Hilary Swank) cross the frontier after she rescues him from hanging.

programme.title: Outlaw Posse
programme.desc: In 1908, Chief (Mario Van Peebles) returns from years of hiding to claim stolen gold. In his quest, he reunites an ensemble of familiar faces. Together, they fight off Angel, whose desire for the gold leaves a trail of dead bodies.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (2014)
programme.desc: When New York City is in trouble, it’s up to the four ninja-fighting, pizza-loving brothers to save it. Aided by determined reporter April O’Neil and their wise master Splinter, these unlikely heroes must face their ultimate nemesis - the evil Shredder.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Out of the Shadows
programme.desc: The Turtles are back to battle a bigger threat alongside April O'Neil and vigilante Casey Jones. As they prepare to take on supervillain Shredder and his henchmen, Bebop and Rocksteady, they find themselves facing an even greater evil: the sinister Krang.

programme.title: Hercules (2014)
programme.desc: The most towering myth of all time meets up with the mission of a real man in this action-adventure thriller that reveals the famed symbol of courage as he’s never been seen before: finding the hero’s heart that beats beneath his colossal image.

programme.title: The Equalizer 2
programme.desc: Denzel Washington returns to one of his signature roles in the first sequel of his career. Robert McCall serves unflinching justice for the exploited and oppressed – but how far will he go when it is someone he loves?

programme.title: Mrs. Doubtfire
programme.desc: An eccentric dad dresses as a British nanny to care for his kids at their mother's home.

programme.title: Role Models
programme.desc: The world's least likely mentors must set aside their selfish ways to impart invaluable wisdom to two kids about life, love, and heavy metal.

programme.title: Succubus
programme.desc: A new father struggling with fatigue, emotional insecurities, and a failing marriage joins a dating app, only to swipe right on what may be an inhuman presence.

programme.title: Winnie-the-Pooh: Blood and Honey
programme.desc: Winnie-The-Pooh: Blood and Honey follows Pooh and Piglet as they go on a rampage after Christopher Robin abandons them.

programme.title: Child's Play (2019)
programme.desc: In this shocking re-imagining of the horror classic, single mother Karen (Aubrey Plaza) buys her son Andy (Gabriel Bateman) a seemingly innocent, AI-enhanced Buddi doll, unaware of its more sinister nature…and its true name…Chucky!

programme.title: Lone Wolf McQuade
programme.desc: A maverick Texas Ranger throws down his guns to indulge his talents in the martial arts when he meets his match in the leader of a gun-smuggling ring.

programme.title: The Octagon
programme.desc: Chuck Norris is back in this action-packed martial arts showcase co-starring the legendary Lee Van Cleef. Norris takes on his adoptive brother and a training camp where terrorists are being taught the secret killing techniques of the ninja!

programme.title: This Is Spinal Tap
programme.desc: Undoubtedly the funniest film ever made about rock and roll, Rob Reiner's satire about an over-the-hill heavy metal band is a priceless look at the music business and its madness.

programme.title: Galaxy Quest
programme.desc: Nearly 20 years after the cult TV show Galaxy Quest was canceled, the cast is asked for help by an alien species to save the universe.

programme.title: Kingpin
programme.desc: A star bowler whose career was prematurely "cut off" hopes to ride a new prodigy to success and riches.

programme.title: The Naked Gun: From the Files of Police Squad!
programme.desc: Leslie Nielsen stars as Police Squad's own granite-jawed, rockbrained cop Frank Drebin, who bumbles across a mind control scheme to assassinate Queen Elizabeth.

programme.title: Zodiac
programme.desc: Based on Robert Graysmith's books about the real-life notorious Zodiac, a serial killer who terrorized San Francisco with a string of seemingly random murders during the 1960s and 1970s.

programme.title: Collateral
programme.desc: Vincent is a cool, calculating contract killer at the top of his game. Max is a cabbie with big dreams and no results. On this fateful night, Max has to transport Vincent on his next job - one night, five stops, five hits and a getaway.

programme.title: Shutter Island
programme.desc: When U.S. Marshal Teddy Daniels arrives at the asylum for the criminally insane on Shutter Island, he uncovers terrifying truths about the island. He finds out that some places never let you go.

programme.title: There Will Be Blood
programme.desc: A sprawling epic about family, faith, power, and oil: the story chronicles the life of Daniel Plainview, who transforms himself from a down-and-out silver miner into a self-made oil tycoon.

programme.title: Basic Instinct
programme.desc: San Francisco detective Nick Curran is investigating the murder of a once-celebrated rock star, and he's made a few unsettling discoveries: a bloody ice pick, a white silk scarf tied to a bedpost, and evidence of an otherwise romantic evening.

programme.title: Hunt for the Wilderpeople
programme.desc: From Academy Award winner Taika Waititi, this heartfelt comedy follows the adventure of a misfit kid (Julian Dennison) and his foster uncle (Sam Neill) who go on the run in the vast New Zealand bush, evading child services and the law.

programme.title: The Fisher King
programme.desc: Parry, a homeless history professor, lives in a fantasy world full of castles, Red Knights, and damsels in distress. Bridges co-stars as Jack, New York's #1 shock deejay, whose offhand arrogance triggers a tragedy that ruins his career. Rated: R

programme.title: Deep Blue Sea
programme.desc: One of nature's most perfect killing machines has been re-engineered as something smarter, faster, and deadlier. When things go wrong, the aquatic killing machines begin hunting their creators, who are alone and adrift on the Deep Blue Sea.

programme.title: Geronimo: An American Legend
programme.desc: An American legend comes to life in this epic Western, starring Jason Patric, Robert Duvall, Gene Hackman, and Wes Studi as Geronimo, who delivers a stunning performance as the fearless warrior who was the last Indian leader to surrender to the white man.

programme.title: Grease
programme.desc: Grease is the one that you want! Go back to high school with Pink Lady Sandy (Olivia Newton-John), leader of the bad-boy T-Birds, Danny (John Travolta), and a rockin' and rollin' all-star cast.

programme.title: Ordinary People
programme.desc: Ordinary People is an intense examination of a family being torn apart by tension and tragedy. Donald Sutherland and Mary Tyler Moore star as the upper-middle-class couple whose “ordinary” existence is irrevocably shattered by death.

programme.title: On a Clear Day You Can See Forever
programme.desc: Daisy Gamble, a woman who hears phones before they ring wants to quit smoking, to please her fiancee, Warren. She goes to a doctor of hypnosis to do it. But once she's under, her doctor finds out that she can regress into past lives.

programme.title: Gattaca
programme.desc: Ethan Hawke, Uma Thurman, Alan Arkin, and Jude Law star in this engrossing sci-fi thriller about an all-too-human man who dares to defy a system obsessed with genetic perfection. Rated: PG-13

programme.title: Hellboy (2004)
programme.desc: Born in the flames of hell and brought to Earth, Hellboy was rescued from sinister forces by the benevolent Dr. Broom, who raised him to be a hero. Hellboy stands as the key line of defense against an evil madman who seeks to destroy mankind.

programme.title: Moon
programme.desc: Sam Bell (Sam Rockwell) is nearing the completion of his 3-year-long contract with Lunar Industries, mining Earth's primary source of energy on the dark side of the moon.

programme.title: Vertical Limit
programme.desc: An emotionally charged action-adventure tale of a retired climber (O'Donnell) who must launch a treacherous and extraordinary rescue effort up K2, the world's second-highest peak, to save his estranged sister and her summit team in a race against time.

programme.title: Blood Diamond
programme.desc: Academy Award nominees Leonardo DiCaprio and Djimon Hounsou join Academy Award winner Jennifer Connelly in this action drama from Ed Zwick, the filmmaker behind The Last Samurai.

programme.title: Body of Lies
programme.desc: Leonardo Di Caprio and Academy Award winner Russell Crowe star in director Ridley Scott's adaptation of the best-selling post-9/11 espionage thriller.

programme.title: The Peanut Butter Falcon
programme.desc: After running away from a residential nursing home to pursue his dream of becoming a pro wrestler, a man who has Down syndrome befriends an outlaw who becomes his coach and ally.

programme.title: Gods of Egypt
programme.desc: A defiant mortal (Brenton Thwaites) forms an unlikely alliance with the powerful god Horus (Nikolaj Coster-Waldau) to save the world from Set (Gerard Butler), the merciless god of darkness.

programme.title: The Last Witch Hunter
programme.desc: The fate of the human race hangs in the balance when the Witch Queen rises from the dead, seeking revenge against Kaulder, the immortal warrior who slayed her centuries ago.

programme.title: The Legend of Hercules
programme.desc: Betrayed by his stepfather, the King, and exiled and sold into slavery because of a forbidden love, Hercules must use his formidable powers to fight his way back to his rightful kingdom.

programme.title: Total Recall
programme.desc: It's 2084 A.D., and Doug Quaid is haunted by recurring dreams about journeying to Earth's closest planetary neighbor, Mars.

programme.title: Terminator 2: Judgment Day
programme.desc: The non-human machine ruling elite of the nuclear war-torn future has dispatched a cyborg assassin into the past to kill a young boy because he soon will be the resistance leader against the machines.

programme.title: Terminator Genisys
programme.desc: When John Connor sends Kyle Reese back to 1984 to protect a young Sarah Connor, unexpected events alter the past and threaten the future of all mankind. Charged with a new mission, Reese must join forces with Sarah and her "Guardian" to save the world.

programme.title: Down in the Delta
programme.desc: In Maya Angelou's directorial debut, a troubled single mother spends the summer at her family's ancestral home in rural Mississippi and learns to reverse the downward slide of her life in this uplifting story of family, community and friendship.

programme.title: Canal Street
programme.desc: After Kholi Styles becomes a suspect in the mysterious death of a classmate, it's up to his father to defend his son and battle an outraged public.

programme.title: Coach Carter
programme.desc: An inspirational account of basketball coach Ken Carter, who received both praise and criticism when he made headlines for benching his entire undefeated team for poor academic performance.

programme.title: Pride
programme.desc: The true, inspiring story of Jim Ellis, a charismatic school teacher who changed lives forever when he founded an African-American swim team in one of Philadelphia's roughest neighborhoods.

programme.title: Star Trek III: The Search for Spock
programme.desc: Admiral Kirk’s defeat of Khan and the creation of the planet Genesis are empty victories. Spock is dead, and McCoy is inexplicably being driven insane. Then a surprise visit from Sarek, Spock’s father, provides a startling revelation.

programme.title: Star Trek IV: The Voyage Home
programme.desc: It’s the 23rd century, and an alien power is evaporating the oceans. To save mankind, Kirk and his crew must time-travel back to 1986, where they find a world of punk, pizza, and exact-change buses that are as alien as anything they’ve ever encountered.

programme.title: Star Trek V: The Final Frontier
programme.desc: Captain Kirk and his crew must deal with Mr. Spock's long-lost half-brother, who hijacks the Enterprise for an obsessive search for God at the center of the galaxy.

programme.title: Bound
programme.desc: Caesar’s a guy who launders money for the mob. What’s the last thing that would come between a sleazy wise guy like Caesar and that money? A couple of women with brains to die for and bodies to match.

programme.title: The Matrix

programme.title: The Matrix Reloaded
programme.desc: In the second chapter of the Matrix trilogy, Zion falls under siege by the Machine Army. Neo and Trinity choose to return to the Matrix with Morpheus. Now, Neo must follow the path he has chosen if he is to save humanity.

programme.title: Rocky

programme.title: Code Name: The Cleaner

programme.title: The Buccaneer
programme.desc: General Andrew Jackson's dependence on the help of pirate Jean Lafitte to repel the British is complicated by the Governor's daughter. Set in New Orleans during the War of 1812.

programme.title: Father Goose
programme.desc: Cary Grant stars in one of his funniest roles as a boozy beachcomber sitting out WWII in peace - until the Allies recruit him to be a lookout on the South Pacific isle.

programme.title: Sands of Iwo Jima
programme.desc: Tough-as-nails career Marine Sergeant John Stryker is greatly disliked by the men of his squad, particularly the combat replacements, for the rigorous training he puts them through.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible - Rogue Nation
programme.desc: Ethan and team take on their most impossible mission yet, eradicating the Syndicate - an International rogue organization as highly skilled as they are, committed to destroying the IMF.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible - Dead Reckoning
programme.desc: Ethan Hunt (Tom Cruise) and his IMF team embark on their most dangerous mission yet: To track down a terrifying new weapon that threatens all of humanity before it falls into the hands of a mysterious, all-powerful enemy.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible - Ghost Protocol
programme.desc: Agent Ethan Hunt and his elite team go underground after a bombing implicates them as terrorists. While trying to clear their name, the team uncovers a plot to start a nuclear war.

programme.title: Stephen King's Thinner
programme.desc: An obese attorney accidentally runs down and kills an old gypsy woman. After her ancient father puts a curse on him, he starts losing weight, and cannot stop. Based on the Stephen King novel, written under the pseudonym Richard Bachman.

programme.title: Stephen King's Graveyard Shift
programme.desc: When a mill is reopened, several employees meet their deaths. The killings all occur between 11 p.m. and 7 a.m. the Graveyard Shift. Soon, the workers find a maze of tunnels leading to the cemetery and the horror that comes alive at night.

programme.title: Stephen King's Silver Bullet
programme.desc: Something is killing off townsfolk in Tarker's Mills. Something ingenious. Something remotely human. But the only person in town with courage to stop this lurking menace is a 13-year-old boy, confined to a wheelchair since birth.

programme.title: Jackie Brown
programme.desc: A female flight attendant becomes a key figure in a plot between the police and an arms dealer.

programme.title: Courage Under Fire
programme.desc: A tank commander reviews another officer's candidacy for a posthumous medal.

programme.title: The Pelican Brief
programme.desc: Academy Award winners Julia Roberts and Denzel Washington star in this thriller about a young law student whose theory about the recent deaths of two Supreme Court justices embroils her in a web of greed, corruption, and murder.

programme.title: A Game of Death
programme.desc: Billy Lo, a champion fighter and movie star, fakes his death to escape and then expose the crime syndicate that wants to control him.

programme.title: The Big Boss
programme.desc: Bruce Lee faces an underground criminal element after members of his family begin disappearing. Now he must break his vow of non-violence to take on the terrifying "Big Boss."

programme.title: Fist of Fury
programme.desc: Bruce Lee stars as Chen Zhen, a martial arts protégé who returns to his former school in Shanghai when he learns that his beloved instructor has been murdered. To avenge his master's death, Chen must fight the greatest assassins from a rival school.

programme.title: Heartbreakers
programme.desc: Max and Page are a mother/daughter con team. Max targets wealthy men and marries them. Page then seduces them while Max "catches" her wayward husbands in the act. Then on to the next mark, posing in a variety of guises to keep one step ahead of the law.

programme.title: Miss Congeniality
programme.desc: International screen sensation Sandra Bullock stars as an FBI agent who goes undercover as a beauty contestant to capture a terrorist in this hilarious action-comedy.

programme.title: Like a Boss
programme.desc: Best friends, Mia and Mel (Tiffany Haddish & Rose Byrne), are running their own cosmetics company when a villainous beauty mogul (Salma Hayek) conspires to steal it. Mia and Mel must stick together and fight to reclaim their company.

programme.title: Failure to Launch
programme.desc: Tripp is a 35-year-old who still lives with his parents. And who can blame him? It’s free, he’s got a great room, and Mom does the laundry. Desperate to get him out of the house, his parents hire a gorgeous woman, Paula, to give him a little…push.

programme.title: Ghosts of Girlfriends Past
programme.desc: Matthew McConaughey stars with Jennifer Garner in this romantic comedy about a committed bachelor who gets a wake-up call from his late, legendary, hard-partying Uncle Wayne and his own Ghosts of Girlfriends Past.

programme.title: Dear John
programme.desc: A soldier on home from leave meets and falls for the love of his life. As time and distance keep them apart, she falls in love with someone else and moves on.

programme.title: Thunderheart
programme.desc: Val Kilmer, Sam Shepard, and Graham Greene star in this murder mystery filled with style and suspense. Kilmer stars as Ray Levoi, a hotshot FBI agent who's thrust into a strange new world when he is sent to solve a murder on an Indian reservation.

programme.title: The Da Vinci Code
programme.desc: A murder in the Louvre and clues in Da Vinci's paintings lead to the discovery of a religious mystery protected by a secret society for two thousand years -- one that could shake the foundations of Christianity.

programme.title: Angels & Demons
programme.desc: Expert symbologist Robert Langdon (Tom Hanks) follows ancient clues on a heart-racing hunt through Rome to find the four Cardinals kidnapped by the deadly secret society, the Illuminati.

programme.title: Saving Private Ryan
programme.desc: A World War II captain (Tom Hanks) and his squad (Edward Burns, Tom Sizemore) risk all to locate and send home a soldier whose three brothers died in combat.

programme.title: The Social Network
programme.desc: The film focuses on the evolution of Facebook, the online social network created in 2004 on the Harvard campus, and how overnight success and wealth changed the lives of the classmates who created it.

programme.title: Antwone Fisher
programme.desc: A troubled sailor who embarks on a remarkable journey to confront his past.

programme.title: Outlaw Posse
programme.desc: In 1908, Chief (Mario Van Peebles) returns from years of hiding to claim stolen gold. In his quest, he reunites an ensemble of familiar faces. Together, they fight off Angel, whose desire for the gold leaves a trail of dead bodies.

programme.title: Billy the Kid
programme.desc: When a bounty hunter kills a member of an outlaw gang, all Hell breaks loose in this shoot-‘em-up tale of gun smoke and justice in the Old West.

programme.title: Dreamland
programme.desc: Discovering a fugitive bank robber (Margot Robbie) is hiding in his small town, a young man is torn between claiming the bounty on her head and his growing attraction to the seductive criminal, in this epic love story set during the Great Depression.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Out of the Shadows
programme.desc: The Turtles are back to battle a bigger threat alongside April O'Neil and vigilante Casey Jones. As they prepare to take on supervillain Shredder and his henchmen, Bebop and Rocksteady, they find themselves facing an even greater evil: the sinister Krang.

programme.title: Hercules (2014)
programme.desc: The most towering myth of all time meets up with the mission of a real man in this action-adventure thriller that reveals the famed symbol of courage as he’s never been seen before: finding the hero’s heart that beats beneath his colossal image.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (2014)
programme.desc: When New York City is in trouble, it’s up to the four ninja-fighting, pizza-loving brothers to save it. Aided by determined reporter April O’Neil and their wise master Splinter, these unlikely heroes must face their ultimate nemesis - the evil Shredder.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Out of the Shadows
programme.desc: The Turtles are back to battle a bigger threat alongside April O'Neil and vigilante Casey Jones. As they prepare to take on supervillain Shredder and his henchmen, Bebop and Rocksteady, they find themselves facing an even greater evil: the sinister Krang.

programme.title: Mrs. Doubtfire
programme.desc: An eccentric dad dresses as a British nanny to care for his kids at their mother's home.

programme.title: Role Models
programme.desc: The world's least likely mentors must set aside their selfish ways to impart invaluable wisdom to two kids about life, love, and heavy metal.

programme.title: Austin Powers: International Man of Mystery
programme.desc: Frozen in the '60s, secret agent Austin Powers is thawed back into action to once again battle his archenemy, Dr. Evil. With his sexy sidekick, Ms. Kensington, Austin must stop Dr. Evil's outrageous plot to control the world.

programme.title: Child's Play (2019)
programme.desc: In this shocking re-imagining of the horror classic, single mother Karen (Aubrey Plaza) buys her son Andy (Gabriel Bateman) a seemingly innocent, AI-enhanced Buddi doll, unaware of its more sinister nature…and its true name…Chucky!

programme.title: Let Me In
programme.desc: Owen, an overlooked and bullied boy, finds love and revenge through Abby (Chloë Grace Moretz of KICK-ASS), a beautiful but peculiar girl who turns out to be a vampire.

programme.title: Diabolic
programme.desc: A woman must return to the fundamentalist compound where she was raised after the vengeful spirit of a cursed witch haunts her.

programme.title: This Is Spinal Tap
programme.desc: Undoubtedly the funniest film ever made about rock and roll, Rob Reiner's satire about an over-the-hill heavy metal band is a priceless look at the music business and its madness.

programme.title: Little Shop of Horrors
programme.desc: Seymour — an orphan and a nerd who works in a run-down flower shop on Skid Row — spends his time doing menial tasks and dreaming of his co-worker, Audrey. Then, one day, just after an eclipse of the sun, Seymour discovers a strange plant.

programme.title: Armed and Dangerous (1986)
programme.desc: John Candy and Eugene Levy charge into the world of private security in the outrageous action-comedy ARMED AND DANGEROUS. Unfortunately, they're usually charging in the wrong direction! Rating: PG-13

programme.title: The Naked Gun: From the Files of Police Squad!
programme.desc: Leslie Nielsen stars as Police Squad's own granite-jawed, rockbrained cop Frank Drebin, who bumbles across a mind control scheme to assassinate Queen Elizabeth.

programme.title: Wayne's World
programme.desc: When a sleazy TV exec offers Wayne and Garth a contract to tape their late-night cable-access show at his network, they discover the road to the big time is full of gnarly twists and turns.

programme.title: Wayne's World 2
programme.desc: Having achieved godlike status as a late-night TV personality, Wayne now confronts the question that has plagued man for centuries: Is there life after cable?

programme.title: Collateral
programme.desc: Vincent is a cool, calculating contract killer at the top of his game. Max is a cabbie with big dreams and no results. On this fateful night, Max has to transport Vincent on his next job - one night, five stops, five hits and a getaway.

programme.title: Shutter Island
programme.desc: When U.S. Marshal Teddy Daniels arrives at the asylum for the criminally insane on Shutter Island, he uncovers terrifying truths about the island. He finds out that some places never let you go.

programme.title: Zodiac
programme.desc: Based on Robert Graysmith's books about the real-life notorious Zodiac, a serial killer who terrorized San Francisco with a string of seemingly random murders during the 1960s and 1970s.

programme.title: Basic Instinct
programme.desc: San Francisco detective Nick Curran is investigating the murder of a once-celebrated rock star, and he's made a few unsettling discoveries: a bloody ice pick, a white silk scarf tied to a bedpost, and evidence of an otherwise romantic evening.

programme.title: Hunt for the Wilderpeople
programme.desc: From Academy Award winner Taika Waititi, this heartfelt comedy follows the adventure of a misfit kid (Julian Dennison) and his foster uncle (Sam Neill) who go on the run in the vast New Zealand bush, evading child services and the law.

programme.title: There Will Be Blood
programme.desc: A sprawling epic about family, faith, power, and oil: the story chronicles the life of Daniel Plainview, who transforms himself from a down-and-out silver miner into a self-made oil tycoon.

programme.title: Deep Blue Sea
programme.desc: One of nature's most perfect killing machines has been re-engineered as something smarter, faster, and deadlier. When things go wrong, the aquatic killing machines begin hunting their creators, who are alone and adrift on the Deep Blue Sea.

programme.title: Geronimo: An American Legend
programme.desc: An American legend comes to life in this epic Western, starring Jason Patric, Robert Duvall, Gene Hackman, and Wes Studi as Geronimo, who delivers a stunning performance as the fearless warrior who was the last Indian leader to surrender to the white man.

programme.title: The Rock
programme.desc: A weapons expert and a prisoner join forces to avert a catastrophe.

programme.title: Ordinary People
programme.desc: Ordinary People is an intense examination of a family being torn apart by tension and tragedy. Donald Sutherland and Mary Tyler Moore star as the upper-middle-class couple whose “ordinary” existence is irrevocably shattered by death.

programme.title: On a Clear Day You Can See Forever
programme.desc: Daisy Gamble, a woman who hears phones before they ring wants to quit smoking, to please her fiancee, Warren. She goes to a doctor of hypnosis to do it. But once she's under, her doctor finds out that she can regress into past lives.

programme.title: Grease
programme.desc: Grease is the one that you want! Go back to high school with Pink Lady Sandy (Olivia Newton-John), leader of the bad-boy T-Birds, Danny (John Travolta), and a rockin' and rollin' all-star cast.

programme.title: Monty Python and the Holy Grail
programme.desc: Grossing the highest box-office of any British film in the US when released in 1975, this "cult classic" comedy from the Monty Python team loosely follows the legend of King Arthur, along with his squire and his Knights of the Round Table.

programme.title: Hellboy (2004)
programme.desc: Born in the flames of hell and brought to Earth, Hellboy was rescued from sinister forces by the benevolent Dr. Broom, who raised him to be a hero. Hellboy stands as the key line of defense against an evil madman who seeks to destroy mankind.

programme.title: Moon
programme.desc: Sam Bell (Sam Rockwell) is nearing the completion of his 3-year-long contract with Lunar Industries, mining Earth's primary source of energy on the dark side of the moon.

programme.title: Deep Blue Sea
programme.desc: One of nature's most perfect killing machines has been re-engineered as something smarter, faster, and deadlier. When things go wrong, the aquatic killing machines begin hunting their creators, who are alone and adrift on the Deep Blue Sea.

programme.title: Blood Diamond
programme.desc: Academy Award nominees Leonardo DiCaprio and Djimon Hounsou join Academy Award winner Jennifer Connelly in this action drama from Ed Zwick, the filmmaker behind The Last Samurai.

programme.title: Body of Lies
programme.desc: Leonardo Di Caprio and Academy Award winner Russell Crowe star in director Ridley Scott's adaptation of the best-selling post-9/11 espionage thriller.

programme.title: Behind Enemy Lines
programme.desc: A Navy navigator is shot down over enemy territory and is pursued by a secret police enforcer.

programme.title: The Last Witch Hunter
programme.desc: The fate of the human race hangs in the balance when the Witch Queen rises from the dead, seeking revenge against Kaulder, the immortal warrior who slayed her centuries ago.

programme.title: The Legend of Hercules
programme.desc: Betrayed by his stepfather, the King, and exiled and sold into slavery because of a forbidden love, Hercules must use his formidable powers to fight his way back to his rightful kingdom.

programme.title: Sisu
programme.desc: During the last days of World War II, a solitary prospector crosses paths with Nazis on a scorched-Earth retreat in northern Finland. When the soldiers decide to steal his gold, they quickly discover they just tangled with no ordinary miner.

programme.title: Boy Kills World
programme.desc: Boy is a mayhem machine who's been training to assassinate the bloodthirsty Hilda Van Der Koy and avenge his family's murder; guided by his sister's mischievous spirit, Boy uncovers one stunning revelation after another as he barrels toward Hilda.

programme.title: Terminator 2: Judgment Day
programme.desc: The non-human machine ruling elite of the nuclear war-torn future has dispatched a cyborg assassin into the past to kill a young boy because he soon will be the resistance leader against the machines.

programme.title: Terminator Genisys
programme.desc: When John Connor sends Kyle Reese back to 1984 to protect a young Sarah Connor, unexpected events alter the past and threaten the future of all mankind. Charged with a new mission, Reese must join forces with Sarah and her "Guardian" to save the world.

programme.title: The Running Man
programme.desc: A wrongly-convicted man must try to survive a public execution gauntlet staged as a TV game show.

programme.title: Coach Carter
programme.desc: An inspirational account of basketball coach Ken Carter, who received both praise and criticism when he made headlines for benching his entire undefeated team for poor academic performance.

programme.title: Pride
programme.desc: The true, inspiring story of Jim Ellis, a charismatic school teacher who changed lives forever when he founded an African-American swim team in one of Philadelphia's roughest neighborhoods.

programme.title: Love & Basketball
programme.desc: Quincy and Monica fall in love as teens and share an all-consuming interest in basketball. Still, they struggle to keep their relationship alive while pursuing success as professional athletes.

programme.title: Star Trek IV: The Voyage Home
programme.desc: It’s the 23rd century, and an alien power is evaporating the oceans. To save mankind, Kirk and his crew must time-travel back to 1986, where they find a world of punk, pizza, and exact-change buses that are as alien as anything they’ve ever encountered.

programme.title: Star Trek V: The Final Frontier
programme.desc: Captain Kirk and his crew must deal with Mr. Spock's long-lost half-brother, who hijacks the Enterprise for an obsessive search for God at the center of the galaxy.

programme.title: Star Trek VI: The Undiscovered Country
programme.desc: After years of war, the Federation and the Klingon Empire find themselves on the brink of a peace summit when an apparent attack from the Enterprise nearly destroys a Klingon ship. Both worlds brace for what may be their deadliest encounter.

programme.title: The Matrix Reloaded
programme.desc: In the second chapter of the Matrix trilogy, Zion falls under siege by the Machine Army. Neo and Trinity choose to return to the Matrix with Morpheus. Now, Neo must follow the path he has chosen if he is to save humanity.

programme.title: The Matrix Revolutions
programme.desc: In this final chapter of the Matrix trilogy, Neo, Morpheus, and Trinity battle to defend Zion against the machines' onslaught that has enslaved the human race. And Neo faces the consequences of the choice made in The Matrix Reloaded.

programme.title: Speed Racer

programme.title: Mrs. Doubtfire
programme.desc: An eccentric dad dresses as a British nanny to care for his kids at their mother's home.

programme.title: Happy Gilmore
programme.desc: A bad-tempered hockey player takes his talent to the golf course to win a tournament prize and save his grandmother's house from the IRS.

programme.title: Wrong Turn
programme.desc: Backwoods terror and nerve-jangling suspense meet when a group of friends hiking the Appalachian Trail come face to face with a community of dangerous mountain dwellers.

programme.title: Scream 2
programme.desc: While away at college, Sidney Prescott thought she'd finally put the terror behind her...until a copycat killer begins acting out a real-life sequel in which no one is safe or beyond suspicion.

programme.title: Little Shop of Horrors
programme.desc: Seymour — an orphan and a nerd who works in a run-down flower shop on Skid Row — spends his time doing menial tasks and dreaming of his co-worker, Audrey. Then, one day, just after an eclipse of the sun, Seymour discovers a strange plant.

programme.title: Three Amigos!
programme.desc: Steve Martin, Chevy Chase and Martin Short are three wild and crazy caballeros in this comedy adventure that’s a fiesta of fun. Co-starring Phil Hartman and Jon Lovitz, the '¡Three Amigos!' blaze a side-splitting trail across the comedy frontier!

programme.title: Planes, Trains & Automobiles
programme.desc: Neal just wants to fly home to Chicago for Thanksgiving with his family. But all he gets is misery. Misery named Del Griffith, a loud-mouthed salesman who leads Neal on a wild goose chase.

programme.title: When Harry Met Sally
programme.desc: As Harry Burns and Sally Albright build their lives and careers in Manhattan, their paths continue to cross, and their friendship continues to grow … until they confront the decision whether to let their friendship develop into romance.

programme.title: Kingpin
programme.desc: A star bowler whose career was prematurely "cut off" hopes to ride a new prodigy to success and riches.

programme.title: Wayne's World
programme.desc: When a sleazy TV exec offers Wayne and Garth a contract to tape their late-night cable-access show at his network, they discover the road to the big time is full of gnarly twists and turns.

programme.title: Wayne's World 2
programme.desc: Having achieved godlike status as a late-night TV personality, Wayne now confronts the question that has plagued man for centuries: Is there life after cable?

programme.title: Collateral
programme.desc: Vincent is a cool, calculating contract killer at the top of his game. Max is a cabbie with big dreams and no results. On this fateful night, Max has to transport Vincent on his next job - one night, five stops, five hits and a getaway.

programme.title: Shutter Island
programme.desc: When U.S. Marshal Teddy Daniels arrives at the asylum for the criminally insane on Shutter Island, he uncovers terrifying truths about the island. He finds out that some places never let you go.

programme.title: Zodiac
programme.desc: Based on Robert Graysmith's books about the real-life notorious Zodiac, a serial killer who terrorized San Francisco with a string of seemingly random murders during the 1960s and 1970s.

programme.title: Basic Instinct
programme.desc: San Francisco detective Nick Curran is investigating the murder of a once-celebrated rock star, and he's made a few unsettling discoveries: a bloody ice pick, a white silk scarf tied to a bedpost, and evidence of an otherwise romantic evening.

programme.title: Coming to America
programme.desc: Join EDDIE MURPHY on an unforgettable comic quest to the New World. As an African Prince, it's time for him to find a princess. The mission leads him and his most loyal friend (ARSENIO HALL) to New York. Watch Murphy and Hall in classic cameo roles!

programme.title: Top Gun
programme.desc: Tom Cruise is superb as Maverick Mitchell, a young flyer who's out to become the best. And Kelly McGillis plays the instructor who teaches Maverick a few things you can't learn in a classroom.

programme.title: Jackie Brown
programme.desc: A female flight attendant becomes a key figure in a plot between the police and an arms dealer.

programme.title: Deep Blue Sea
programme.desc: One of nature's most perfect killing machines has been re-engineered as something smarter, faster, and deadlier. When things go wrong, the aquatic killing machines begin hunting their creators, who are alone and adrift on the Deep Blue Sea.

programme.title: Any Given Sunday
programme.desc: Academy Award winner Al Pacino and Cameron Diaz lead a stellar cast in Oscar-winning Oliver Stone's hard-hitting homage to the gridiron gladiators of Any Given Sunday.

programme.title: Monty Python's Life of Brian
programme.desc: A notorious religious satire, the film tells the story of Brian (Graham Chapman), a reluctant would-be messiah who rises to prominence as a result of a series of absurd and truly hilarious circumstances.

programme.title: Grease
programme.desc: Grease is the one that you want! Go back to high school with Pink Lady Sandy (Olivia Newton-John), leader of the bad-boy T-Birds, Danny (John Travolta), and a rockin' and rollin' all-star cast.

programme.title: Rockers
programme.desc: Night Flight Presents: Starring Leroy 'Horsemouth' Wallace and Richard 'Dirty Harry' Hall; ROCKERS is a story of oppressed Jamaican musicians getting even with the 'mafia types' in the business

programme.title: Gravity

programme.title: The Mummy (1999)

programme.title: The Mummy Returns
programme.desc: Brendan Fraser and an all-star cast reunite in this action-packed adventure where an accursed mummy is resurrected – along with a force even more powerful: The Scorpion King (The Rock).

programme.title: Vertical Limit
programme.desc: An emotionally charged action-adventure tale of a retired climber (O'Donnell) who must launch a treacherous and extraordinary rescue effort up K2, the world's second-highest peak, to save his estranged sister and her summit team in a race against time.

programme.title: Just Like Heaven
programme.desc: He's convinced she's a spirit. She's convinced she's still alive. As they search for the truth of Elizabeth's past, their relationship changes from resentment to romance.

programme.title: Kate & Leopold
programme.desc: When a rip in time brings together a charming 19th-century bachelor and a thoroughly 21st-century woman, the potential for an old-fashioned modern romance ignites!

programme.title: Gods of Egypt
programme.desc: A defiant mortal (Brenton Thwaites) forms an unlikely alliance with the powerful god Horus (Nikolaj Coster-Waldau) to save the world from Set (Gerard Butler), the merciless god of darkness.

programme.title: The Last Witch Hunter

programme.title: The Legend of Hercules

programme.title: Kindergarten Cop

programme.title: The Running Man

programme.title: Jingle All the Way
programme.desc: A father's Christmas Eve turns into a madcap scramble to find a much-sought-after toy for his son.

programme.title: Coach Carter

programme.title: Boomerang
programme.desc: Advertising executive Marcus Graham is a quintessential bachelor. Graham is never without a new lady on his arm. Enter Jacqueline, his new boss, and Marcus is on the receiving end of his own patented behavior for the first time!

programme.title: Harlem Nights
programme.desc: In the waning days of Prohibition, Sugar Ray and his adopted son, Quick, run a speakeasy called Club Sugar Ray. Gangster Bugsy Calhoune pays corrupt cop Phil Cantone to close Club Sugar Ray down.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Motion Picture - The Director's Edition
programme.desc: The U.S.S. Enterprise proudly soars again in this new, beautifully restored Director's Edition of the original Star Trek movie classic. This edition features enhanced visual effects and a new sound mix, supervised by legendary director Robert Wise.

programme.title: Star Trek II: The Wrath of Khan

programme.title: Star Trek III: The Search for Spock

programme.title: Star Trek IV: The Voyage Home

programme.title: Speed Racer

programme.desc: A World War II captain (Tom Hanks) and his squad (Edward Burns, Tom Sizemore) risk all to locate and send home a soldier whose three brothers died in combat.

programme.title: G.I. Joe: Retaliation
programme.desc: The greatest American Heroes are back, and they've been set up to take the fall for a heinous crime they didn't commit. Roadblock (Dwayne Johnson) leads a new team (including Channing Tatum and Bruce Willis) on this high-octane adventure.

programme.title: Transformers

programme.title: Role Models
programme.desc: The world's least likely mentors must set aside their selfish ways to impart invaluable wisdom to two kids about life, love, and heavy metal.

programme.title: The Bounty Hunter (2010)
programme.desc: Milo is a bounty hunter who gets his dream job when he is assigned to track down his bail-jumping reporter ex-wife. When she gives him the slip so she can chase a lead on a murder cover-up, Milo realizes that nothing ever goes smoothly with her.

programme.title: The Curious Case of Benjamin Button
programme.desc: Brad Pitt and Cate Blanchett star in the adaption of F. Scott Fitzgerald's story about an elderly man who ages backward and the problems that arise when he falls in love with a woman.

programme.title: Scream 3

programme.title: Wes Craven Presents: Dracula 2000
programme.desc: Master of horror Wes Craven presents a sexy, modern-day adaptation of the classic Gothic thriller. After Dracula is awakened from his 100-year slumber, he makes America his first destination, specifically the exotic city of New Orleans.

programme.title: Amityville: A New Generation

programme.title: Risky Business
programme.desc: Meet Joel Goodsen, an industrious college-bound seventeen-year-old, a responsible and trustworthy son ... Meet Lana, young, hot, exquisite and street-smart.

programme.title: Real Genius

programme.title: Armed and Dangerous (1986)

programme.title: The Naked Gun 2 1/2: The Smell of Fear
programme.desc: Lt. Frank Drebin (Leslie Nielsen) loves a mystery. Why are we here? Is there life after sex? Yes, Drebin tackles the big issues— and the biggest of all is how to stop devious Quentin Hapsburg’s (Robert Goulet) plan to destroy the environment!

programme.title: Naked Gun 33 1/3: The Final Insult
programme.desc: Oscar® night. Will someone please kick that numbskull off-stage? Wait! That’s no ordinary numbskull. That’s Lt. Frank Drebin, crashing the ceremonies to stop a terrorist plot!

programme.title: Daddy's Home

programme.title: Arthur: The Perfect Game/D.W.'s Furry Freakout

programme.title: Arthur: D.W.'s Time Trouble/Buster's Amish Mismatch
programme.desc: D.W. is tired of being bossed around all the time and demands to know why she couldn't have been born before Arthur! And during a trip to Amish country, Buster becomes enamored with the simple life and vows to forgo modern conveniences.

programme.title: Arthur: Feeling Flush/Family Fortune
programme.desc: During a drought, Francine bets Arthur that her family can use less water than his. The TV show, Treasure Caravan, is coming to Elwood City! Arthur and D.W. are convinced they'll find treasures that will make them rich and famous.

programme.title: Arthur: Prunella's Special Edition/The Secret Life Of Dogs & Babies
programme.desc: The latest book about everyone's favorite boy wizard--Henry Skreever--is finally out! Every kid in town is lining up to get it, except Prunella, who's ordered a limited edition from England. Ever wonder what Baby Kate and Pal are thinking?

programme.title: Arthur: The Lousy Week/You Are Arthur
programme.desc: An army of lice has descended on the heads of Lakewood Elementary. Who or what is strong enough to defeat them? What if you could be Arthur for a day? View Arthur's life through his very own eyes for this special episode.

programme.title: Arthur: The Curse of the Grebes/Arthur Changes Gears
programme.desc: The Elwood City Grebes haven't won the Baseball Championship since 1918. But with the addition of three players, the title is finally within reach. Arthur finally saves enough money to buy the bike of his dreams!

programme.title: Arthur: Buster's Secret Admirer/The Last King of Lambland
programme.desc: Buster receives a box of chocolates in the mail from a secret admirer. It's driving him crazy! Who could possibly like him that much? And James receives a gift from his uncle in Scotland--a toy lamb that will give its owner special powers!

programme.title: Arthur: War of the Worms/I Owe You One
programme.desc: Brain is always taking the fun out of Fern's storytelling by correcting her facts, but things gets out of hand when Fern tricks him with a fake story! Buster is always asking for favors. Will he learn the real meaning of friendship?

programme.title: Arthur: Double Tibble Trouble/Arthur's Almost Live Not Real Music Festival
programme.desc: Playing with the Tibble twins requires preparation, endurance and earplugs. But when one gets sick, playing with the other should be a lot easier, right? Arthur and the gang create their own music videos.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Hall of Fame Game
programme.desc: Allen heads to an auction with Elle, while Ton and Big Sis revamp the shop to help bring in more customers. Allen unearths a Ouija board and a set of antique basketballs, and goes toe-to-toe with an NBA Hall of Famer.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: The Dallas Mavericks
programme.desc: Military-grade Tomahawk cruise missile jet engine; century-old handcrafted wild west cowboy saddle; 1960s high roller's gold money.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Party Gras
programme.desc: On a trip to New Orleans, Ton and Allen look to mix business with pleasure. They wage war with some locals at a tough auction, win a Mardi Gras unit that contains a confetti blaster and a modern calliope, then hit the town.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Tough as Nails
programme.desc: CJ seeks to disrupt Allen's search for serenity at a storage auction before the guy's head to a live auction to buy and sell. They uncover an unusual Marilyn Monroe statue, an industrial slip n' slide, and a bed of nails.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: To Pawn or Not To Pawn
programme.desc: On the brink of a major decision, Ton and Allen face-off with Carolyn at an auction in Covina. They win a "special effects unit" that contains big machines for crazy stunt work. The guys decide the fate of the shop.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Allen's Got Balls
programme.desc: After returning to LA, Ton & Allen head deep into hostile auction hunter territory and butt heads with a familiar old foe! They discover a driving range golf ball picker vehicle and one of the most accurate rifles ever made!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Louisiana Purchase
programme.desc: In Louisiana, Ton and Allen encounter some salty locals at a shipping crate auction, and navigate choppy waters at a boat auction. After spending a lot of cash, they find a tactical blast shield and a bass fishing boat.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Sidecar Surprise
programme.desc: An unassuming mom in an oversized sweater tries to pull the wool over Ton & Allen's eyes at a storage auction in Arlington, VA. The guys uncover a black powder cannon designed in the 15th century & a Russian military motorcycle!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Drumming Up Cash
programme.desc: Ton & Allen face some silent but deadly competition at an auction in nearby Glendale. They discover a Zildjian brand percussion cymbal from the 1940's and a pyrotechnics control board designed for large-scale fireworks displays!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Viva la Vegas
programme.desc: 1974 death-defying Zig Zag magic sword box, an ultra-rare 1910 poster of the infamous magician Chung Ling Soo, an 1800s naval cane sword and century-old Metlach German beer steins.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Quadzilla Attacks!
programme.desc: Extreme Quadzilla ATV, the fastest 4 wheeler ever; a 1910s Remington Derringer and an 1880s Palm Squeezer pistol; revolutionary 1800s Western Electric telephone with a crank dial.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: The Lemmings are having a rave party. When Grizzy throws their stereo into the river, he sparks a general power outage and is unable to watch his favourite shows.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: Grizzy can't believe his eyes when he sees objects moving all by themselves. He soon realises it's the Lemmings who are playing around with a magnet.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: Grizzy is persuaded that the she-bear he's in love with has been turned into a frog. Whilst he looks through books of fairy tales, searching for a means to return his beloved to her original form, the Lemmings try to recover the frog.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: Grizzy discovers a baby raccoon not far from the log cabin. When he sees its big moist eyes, Grizzy melts and adopts the creature. When the Lemmings drag the baby into their dangerous games, the overprotective Grizzy steps in.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: Grizzy discovers the pleasures of video games on the ranger's console. The Lemmings want to try their hand at the joystick but Grizzy refuses to interrupt his kart racing game.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: Grizzy builds a look-alike robot to keep the Lemmings away while he prepares a party for his beloved she-bear. But his double's artificial intelligence leaves a lot to be desired.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings
programme.desc: When he brandishes an Indian sceptre that the Lemmings brought home with other antique objects, Grizzy sees the Lemmings bow low before him and behave like servants.

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings

programme.title: Disaster DIY
programme.desc: Alex's plans to finish a laundry room for his wife Muriam, have been stuck in the spin cycle since he began tearing the room a part three years ago.

programme.title: Disaster DIY
programme.desc: Christine decided to renovate her entire basement and now her family is left with an unusable space surrounded by mismatched cabinetry and a crumbling foundation.

programme.title: Disaster DIY
programme.desc: Danny's little knowledge of even basic renovation tasks like measuring and cutting didn't stop him from completely gutting a staple room in his family's home - the kitchen.

programme.title: Disaster DIY
programme.desc: Claire's dream Master Bathroom has taken so long, the dream is slowly descending into a full on nightmare.

programme.title: Disaster DIY
programme.desc: Maria wishes she could borrow a professional contractor to finish the ongoing renovations in her first house with soon-to-be husband

programme.title: Disaster DIY
programme.desc: And the award for 'Most Procrastinated Renovation' goes to Scot's movie theatre that has been in progress for 10 years. Scot promised his wife Alina a cool game and movie theatre area when their first son was a toddler.

programme.title: Disaster DIY
programme.desc: There's a thin line between perfectionist and professional procrastinator and Joe claims to be the former, but is actually the latter. His wife Sharyn is tired of her husband's perfectionist excuse.

programme.title: Disaster DIY
programme.desc: Kim has put up with the family's beastly backyard ever since the family moved in five years ago. Her husband Dave, a comic artist who is used to being the teacher, has everything to learn about renovations.

programme.title: Disaster DIY
programme.desc: Donald's mother is tired of hosting holiday functions because her son's kitchen has been mid-renovation for the last few years. Despite being an expert landscape artist, Donald's skills in the kitchen are novice at best.

programme.title: Disaster DIY
programme.desc: Not only has Jeff lost his kitchen, he's close to losing his sanity. His wife Paula has taken it upon herself to pioneer the kitchen renovations in her house and has her own wacky ideas of how to do so.

programme.title: Disaster DIY
programme.desc: Blame stubbornness, lack of know-how, or both, but Ms. Gabriel's backyard has taken a backseat in upkeep over the last few years. Her idea of fixing the fence is using coat hangers to keep fence boards from falling down.

programme.title: Scott's Own Vacation House
programme.desc: Scott and his team are in the homestretch of several renos on his new vacation property, with the final task being a top-to-bottom overhaul of the boathouse and the upper deck adding some much-needed shore appeal.

programme.title: Income Property
programme.desc: Jeremy and Angie need to renovate their dilapidated basement apartment because they desperately need the income. If they don’t rent it out they will forgo the dream of Angie staying home to raise their young son.

programme.title: Income Property
programme.desc: Henri and Lori need to renovate their outdated income suite fast so that they can maintain the income they’ve relied on to help offset their heavy business taxes.

programme.title: Income Property
programme.desc: Courtney and Emily need to get their unfinished basement renovated to a high standard apartment ASAP to be able to afford the extra $100,000 mortgage they took on to buy the home.

programme.title: Income Property
programme.desc: Bonnie and Merv have credit card debt in addition to a big mortgage. They need Scott’s help to complete their basement income suite so that they can get out of debt and down the aisle before the end of the year.

programme.title: Income Property
programme.desc: Laura and Peter need to convert the existing professional office space in the basement into a stunning apartment suitable for their cool neighbourhood.

programme.title: Income Property
programme.desc: Antoinette and Mike need a safe income suite tout de suite because Antoinette is expecting and they need the extra income.

programme.title: Income Property
programme.desc: During 18 months of unemployment, Crystal came to depend on her improvised, second floor apartment to avoid defaulting on her mortgage while racking up major debts to keep the house running.

programme.title: Income Property
programme.desc: Rushad wants to move out of his parents’ house and into the triplex he bought last fall. Unfortunately unless he can get the main floor/basement suite renovated and rented, that’s never going to happen.

programme.title: Income Property
programme.desc: Andrea and Luke have a five-year financial plan based on the second floor apartment being consistently rented.

programme.title: Income Property
programme.desc: Tracey fell in love with her home the first day she saw it. But she has since done more destruction than construction and has lost the passion she once felt for her home.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow
programme.desc: Exploring the history of food, with objects that reveal centuries of cooking, from farmhouse fare to royal banquets; Dame Mary Berry joins Fiona Bruce to reminisce about her life in cooking.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow
programme.desc: Confronting a goblin figurine, a 17th-century amulet and a collection of signed Tolkien books; looking at the guitar that underpinned '60s British rock; exploring YMCA items that salute female WWI volunteers; studying innovative ceramic repairs.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow
programme.desc: The team visit Thirlestane Castle in the Scottish Borders, where treasures include an Art Nouveau claret jug, a full-size leather tiger and an ice-axe signed by famous mountaineers.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow
programme.desc: The team returns to Beaumaris Castle, Anglesey, where finds include trophies from the Isle of Man TT race.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow
programme.desc: The team visits Belfast's Botanic Gardens, where Fiona Bruce explores its history; treasures include early poetry by Seamus Heaney and an item that made motorcycling history.

programme.title: Chaos City: Kaltgestellt
programme.desc: Mike hat mit seiner Ex-Freundin zu kämpfen, die ein Kind von ihm will. Er muss außerdem Frieden stiften, nachdem der Bürgermeister kurz vor der Reunion einer Band deren Auflösung verursacht.

programme.title: Cheers: Lieber schwul als heiraten
programme.desc: Rebecca hat ihre geplatzte Hochzeit mit Robin noch nicht ganz verkraftet. Endlich kann Sam sie dazu bewegen, ihr verschwitztes Brautkleid auszuziehen. Durch ein Missverständnis glaubt Rebecca, Sam sei in sie verliebt.

programme.title: Cheers: Nur einmal pro Jahr

programme.title: Cheers: Der Immobilienkrieg
programme.desc: Rebecca will Sam das Cheers abkaufen. Sam macht sich nur über sie lustig. Der Yuppie-Gastronom John Allen Hill, dem das Billardzimmer und die Toiletten der Bar gehören, nutzt die Gunst der Stunde.

programme.title: Cheers: Alle Macht den Frauen
programme.desc: Sam und die anderen planen eine große Geburtstagsparty für Frasier. Aber nicht alle sind in Feierstimmung: Woody ist eifersüchtig auf Kellys französischen Freund.

programme.title: Cheers: Chili im Cheers
programme.desc: Rebecca hat das Billardzimmer gegen Sams Willen in einen biederen Teesalon umfunktioniert. Sam will das nicht akzeptieren. Sie bietet ihm eine Wette an. Wenn der Salon nicht bis zum Ende des Tages 500 Dollar Umsatz erwirtschaftet, gibt sie ihn wieder auf.

programme.title: Cheers: Die beste Kellnerin von Boston
programme.desc: Carla steht unter Leistungsdruck: Sie will die Wahl zu besten Kellnerin Bostons gewinnen. Als Preis winkt ein schickes Cabrio. Dann erfährt Carla, dass Cliff zu den Juroren gehören soll. In ihrem Ehrgeiz verabreicht sie ihm sogar Privatmassagen.

programme.title: Cheers: Alles Glückssache
programme.desc: Sam wird von Dutch Kincaid, seinem Widersacher aus alten Baseballzeiten, herausgefordert. Er soll sich mit ihm in einem Gedenkspiel messen. Zunächst weigert sich Sam. Denn Kincaid hat ihn bisher immer besiegt.

programme.title: Cheers: Ein schwerer Verlust
programme.desc: Lilith kann über den Tod ihrer favorisierten Laborratte Whitey nicht hinwegkommen. Deshalb trägt sie deren sterbliche Überreste in der Handtasche spazieren. Frasier will den Kadaver in den Müll werfen.

programme.title: Cheers: Babysitter Sam
programme.desc: Frasier und Lilith suchen dringend einen Babysitter für ihren kleinen Frederick. Sie müssen mit Chefchaot Sam vorlieb nehmen.

programme.desc: Carmens Schwangerschaftstest ist positiv. Doch wer aus der Heerschar ihrer Verehrer könnte der Vater sein? Angesichts des unehelichen Nachwuchses gerät Dieter in Panik. Wenn der Leibliche nicht aufzutreiben ist, muss eben Ersatz gefunden werden.

programme.desc: Bei den Krauses fehlt es hinten und vorne: Mutter Lisbeth wird das Haushaltsgeld knapp, den Kindern das Taschengeld. Nur einer lebt in Saus und Braus: Bodo, Krauses Lieblings-Dackel. Der Zorn der Familie steigert sich zum Wahnsinn: Bodo muss weg!

programme.title: Hausmeister Krause - Ordnung muss sein: Geiseln ohne Gnade

programme.title: Schnell Ermittelt

programme.title: Schnell Ermittelt

programme.title: Schnell Ermittelt

programme.title: Kommissar Rex

programme.title: Kommissar Rex

programme.title: Kommissar Rex
programme.desc: Nach dem Mord an einer Rocksängerin deutet zunächst alles auf deren Ex-Freund. Ein ehemaliges Bandmitglied als Täter. Ihre Freundin jedoch findet mit Fabbris Hilfe den wahren Mörder und begibt sich damit in große Gefahr. Rex muss helfen.

programme.title: Kommissar Rex

programme.title: Kommissar Rex
programme.desc: Tony, Sohn aus reichem Hause, wird auf seiner opulenten Geburtstagsfeier erstochen. Sein Bruder wird vermisst. Ein verdächtiger Freund kommt zu Tode. Fabbri will mit Rex' Hilfe herausfinden, was bei den verwöhnten Jugendlichen los ist.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey

programme.title: The Librarians: Die Fee der Schneekugel
programme.desc: Als Cassandra während einer Mission plötzlich handlungsunfähig ist, beschließt sie, dass es höchste Zeit ist, Urlaub zu machen. Auf der Suche nach ihrer idealen Stadt stößt sie auf Havenport, die "sicherste Stadt in Amerika".

programme.title: The Librarians: Das zerbrochene Medaillon
programme.desc: Die Nachstellung einer historischen Schlacht in einer Stadt namens Feud wird von Geistern heimgesucht.

programme.title: The Librarians: Der Typ namens Jeff
programme.desc: Jenkins tauscht versehentlich den Körper mit einem 28-jährigen Taugenichts namens Jeff. Nun muss er seinen Weg zurück in die Library finden, um den Fehler auszubügeln.

programme.title: The Librarians: Der Kampf auf Leben und Tod
programme.desc: Es ist an der Zeit, den einen Librarian zu bestimmen, der mit Baird verbunden sein wird. Da niemand diese Entscheidung treffen will, hilft die Library selbst dabei.

programme.title: The Librarians: Die Echos der Erinnerung
programme.desc: Die Welt wurde in einen furchtbaren und nicht wiederzuerkennenden Ort verwandelt, an dem die Librarians nie existiert haben.

programme.title: The Librarians: Die Krone von König Artus
programme.desc: Die Mitglieder der Geheimorganisation „The Librarians“ haben sich geschworen, die Welt vor der magischen Wirklichkeit zu beschützen, die jenseits der menschlichen Wahrnehmung existiert.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Mr. Haff Goes To Washington
programme.desc: Ton und Allen attackieren die Hauptstadt der Nation, stoßen jedoch auf starken Widerstand lokaler Bieter. Die Jungs entdecken einen Schwarzpulver-Revolver aus der Zeit des Bürgerkriegs und einen Vorrat an südafrikanischen Goldmünzen.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Sidecar Surprise
programme.desc: Eine unschuldig wirkende Mutter in einem übergroßen Pullover versucht bei einer Lagerauktion in Arlington, VA, Ton und Allens übers Ohr zu hauen. Die Jungs entdecken eine im 15. Jahrhundert entworfene.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Fake Punt Payday
programme.desc: Ton und Allen kämpfen mit vielen unerfahrenen Auktionskäufern bei einer riesigen Containerauktion in Pasadena. Sie finden eine kleine Flotte von Segway-Personentransportern und eine riesige maßgeschneiderte Schrotflinte.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Hidden Hot Wheels
programme.desc: Ton und Allen fordern einen großen Auktionskäufer in seinen heimischen Gefilden heraus. Die Jungs entdecken ein 1969er Chevelle Malibu Muscle Car und eine Single-Shot-Pistole.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Gangs of New York
programme.desc: Ton und Allen duellieren sich mit einer örtlichen Secondhand-Bande bei einer Lagerauktion in Brooklyn. Die Jungs entdecken ein klassisches Arcade-Redemption-Spiel und einen Wasserwerfer aus der Mitte des Jahrhunderts zur Bekämpfung von Infernos.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: The Jersey Score
programme.desc: Ton und Allen nehmen an einer stillen Auktion teil, aber das hindert die lokalen Käufer nicht daran, ihnen mitzuteilen, dass sie nicht willkommen sind. Sie entdecken eine Skeet-Wurfmaschine aus den 60ern und einen Oldtimer mit echter Leistung.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Bowling Pin Payday
programme.desc: Die Jungs besuchen Tons alte Jagdgründe und treten gegen einen schimpfenden Auktionskäufer an. Sie entdecken ein Gewehr aus dem 19. Jahrhundert mit einem passenden Bajonett und eine mechanische Bowling-Stecknadel aus den frühen 1960er Jahren.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Allen's Got Balls
programme.desc: Nach ihrer Rückkehr nach LA begeben sich Ton und Allen tief in feindliches Gebiet und treffen auf einen alten bekannten Feind. Sie entdecken ein Driving Range Golfball Picker Fahrzeug und eines der genauesten Gewehre, die jemals hergestellt wurden.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Dead Aim
programme.desc: Ton und Allen treten gegen einen Auktionskäufer mit zwielichtigen Gebotstaktiken und noch fragwürdigeren Sinn für Mode an. Die Jungs finden ein speziell angefertigtes Monowheel und ein Gewehr.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Ice, Ice, Baby
programme.desc: Ton und Allen reisen zum ersten Mal nach Denver, CO, um nach all möglichem Ausschau zu halten. Aber bei der riesigen Anzahl an lokalen Bietern müssen sie jede einzelne Lagereinheit im Auge behalten.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Little-ton Jones
programme.desc: Allen und Ton versuchen, einen Einblick in ihre Konkurrenz zu bekommen, indem sie sich mit lokalen Auktionskäufern unterhalten. Die Jungs finden einige schwere Goldminenmaschinen aus den 1950er Jahren und eine Amateurrakete mit Schallgeschwindigkeit.

programme.title: Hunan, Die andere Welt von Avatar
programme.desc: Im Südwesten Chinas, im Herzen der Provinz Hunan, befindet sich der Zhangjiajie, einer der schönsten Parks der Welt. Mit seinen 3000 Gipfeln, die in den Himmel ragen, bietet er Landschaften, die atemberaubend, aber auch mysteriös sind.

programme.title: Städte am Meer: Hamburg
programme.desc: Hamburg – die norddeutsche Metropole lebt vom Wasser. Seit dem Mittelalter bringt der Handel über die Meere der Hansestadt Wohlstand. Elbe und Alster prägen den Alltag ihrer Bewohner.

programme.title: Aerial America – Amerika von oben: West Virginia
programme.desc: John Denver besang die "Country Roads" von West Virginia und setzte dem US-Bundesstaat damit ein musikalisches Denkmal. West Virginia blickt auf eine bewegte Geschichte zurück.

programme.title: Geo-Reportage
programme.desc: Auf der ganzen Welt wird Tango getanzt. Dabei steht er auf den ersten Blick im Widerspruch zur Emanzipation, denn die wichtigste Regel des Tangos ist: "Der Mann führt, die Frau lässt sich führen".

programme.title: Unsere wilde Schweiz: Das Oberengadin
programme.desc: Das Oberengadin – eine wilde Landschaft rund um die Engadiner Seenplatte.

programme.title: Unsere wilde Schweiz: Der Vanil Noir
programme.desc: Das Naturpardies Vanil Noir – eine wilde Schönheit in der Schweiz.

programme.desc: Der Aletschgletscher – ein Eisgigant und einmaliges bedrohtes Naturdenkmal.

programme.title: Unsere wilde Schweiz: Das Verzascatal
programme.desc: Das Tessiner Verzascatal ist eines der schönsten Täler der Alpen.

programme.title: Wallacea – Expedition zur Wiege der Meeresfauna
programme.desc: Die Dokumentation besucht eines der letzten Naturparadiese der Erde: das malaiische Archipel.

programme.title: Helden der Evolution: Nilpferde und Nashörner
programme.desc: In der afrikanischen Wildnis leben sie oft in unmittelbarer Nachbarschaft. „Just Animals“ zeigt Flusspferde und Nashörner in ihrer natürlichen Umgebung.

programme.title: Helden der Evolution: Antilopen
programme.desc: Rund 90 Antilopenarten gibt es auf der Erde. 70 davon sind in der Wildnis Afrikas zu Hause. Um sie geht es in dieser Episode von „Just Animals“.

programme.title: Helden der Evolution: Bären
programme.desc: Bären gehören zu den größten und stärksten Säugetieren überhaupt. Sie sind stammesgeschichtlich mit den Hunden verwandt und in den unterschiedlichsten Lebensräumen zu Hause.

programme.title: Helden der Evolution: Großkatzen
programme.desc: Katzenartige Raubtiere sind ebenso geschmeidige wie effektive Jäger, die in vielen Naturlandschaften der Erde an der Spitze der Nahrungskette stehen.

programme.title: Wer waren die alten Griechen?: Teil 1
programme.desc: Dr. Michael Scott reist durch Griechenland, besucht antike Städte und Schlachtfelder, großartige Ruinen und wilde Landschaften – alles, um herauszufinden, wie die alten Griechen gelebt haben.

programme.title: Wer waren die alten Griechen?: Teil 2
programme.desc: Dr. Michael Scott reist weiter zu Orten der griechischen Antike: Athen, Olympia, Makedonien, Türkei, Sizilien, um herauszufinden, warum die Griechen so erfolgreich waren und sich ihre Kultur und ihr Lebensstil über die Kontinente hinweg ausgebreitet hat.

programme.title: Karthagos vergessene Krieger
programme.desc: Der Film rekonstruiert die wissenschaftlich wahrscheinlichen Etappen einer antiken transatlantischen Schiffsexpedition von Europa nach Südamerika. Dort gibt das Kriegervolk der Chachapoya Forschern Rätsel...

programme.title: Das Geheimnis der Wunder von Lourdes
programme.desc: Was genau sind eigentlich Wunder? Wann erkennt die katholische Kirche sie offiziell an? Und kann die Wissenschaft wirklich für alle eine Erklärung liefern?

programme.title: Ägyptens Totenstadt – Die Geheimnisse von Sakkara
programme.desc: Sakkara, Nekropole und Ausgrabungsstätte von Weltrang. Philippe Collombert entdeckt rätselhafte Relikte, die einen Wendepunkt in der Geschichte Ägyptens markieren.

programme.title: Extraordinary Humans: Human Cat; Human Bat

programme.title: Extraordinary Humans: Super-Brain; Music Master
programme.desc: Thom trifft jemanden, der den Zauberwürfel blind enträtseln kann und einen, der nach einmaligem Hören ein ganzes Musikstück auswendig gelernt hat.

programme.title: Extraordinary Humans: Ron White
programme.desc: Thom Hunt reist in die USA, wo er Ron White aufspürt, einen Mann, dessen unfassbares Gedächtnis keiner fassen kann.

programme.title: Extraordinary Humans: Scott Flansburg
programme.desc: Thom ist in Nevada und besucht den Mathematik-Rekordhalter Scott Flansburg, der schneller rechnen kann als ein Taschenrechner.

programme.title: Extraordinary Humans: Dean Karnazes

programme.title: Meine Familie & Ich TV Gastspiel

programme.title: Meine Familie & Ich TV Gastspiel
